Puttu LakshmiNarayana

Senior Technical Lead

+91-9035065220 | puttu.lakshminarayana@gmail.com | Bengaluru, INDIA | Experience: 14 Years 0 Month | https://www.linkedin.com/in/puttu-lakshmi-nnarayana-70146a21/

Profile summary

Senior Tech Lead | Backend Engineer 14 Years in Java, Microservices, and Scalable Systems Senior Tech Lead & Backend Engineer with 14 years of experience in Java (J2SE, J2EE), Spring Boot, and Microservices. Expertise in distributed systems, high-performance APIs, and cloud-native architectures. Skilled in Kafka, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD automation. Strong leadership in team mentoring, architecture decisions, and scaling systems. Key Achievements: ✔ Scaled high-traffic application modules, handling millions of transactions/day with 99.99% uptime. ✔ Optimized API response times by 40% using indexing, caching, and query tuning. ✔ Architected microservices for seamless integration with Adyen Drop in, PayPal, and Trustly for payment and application modules. ✔ Lowered deployment time by 60% through containerized microservices and CI/CD automation. Focused on building scalable systems, improving performance, and mentoring teams.

Skills: Java, J2EE, Spring, Spring Boot, JSON, MySQL, MongoDB, JUnit, MVC Architecture, Microservices, Java Design

Patterns, Kafka, Redis, GIT, Maven, Docker, Kubernetes, API Gateway, Java Spring Framework, Unit Testing, Mockito,

Performance Tuning, Cursor, CI/CD Pipeline, REST API Design, JPA, Hibernate, Hexagonal Architecture, Event-Driven

Architecture

Work experience

Senior Technical Lead – Nextory Pvt. Ltd.

Oct 2016 - Present

Key Contributions & Technical Expertise:

Enterprise Application Design

Designed and implemented OOP-based reusable modules that decreased code duplication by 35% and cut feature

delivery time by 20%.

Lessened technical debt by 40% and improved code maintainability by implementing Clean and Hexagonal architecture,

along with Java design patterns like Factory, Singleton, and Strategy.

Microservices Development

Designed and deployed scalable microservices for User, Library, Payment, and Product modules using Spring Boot and

Spring Cloud, reducing API response time by 30% and supporting 10K+ concurrent users.

Built secure, scalable APIs with JWT-based authentication, pagination, and robust exception handling, improving system

reliability and reducing production errors by 40%.

Event-Driven Architecture with Kafka

Built high-throughput, event-driven systems with Apache Kafka (10K+ events/sec), enabling real-time processing and

reducing data latency by 50%.

Integrated Kafka into order, payment, and subscription workflows, decoupling services and improving system resilience,

resulting in 40% fewer service failures.

Data-Driven Applications using Apache Camel

Engineered data-driven integration pipelines using Apache Camel and EIPs, processing 500K+ messages/day and

reducing integration latency by 40%, enabling real-time communication across 5+ internal systems..

Database Engineering

Designed and optimized high-performance applications using MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis, reducing average query

response time by 60%.

Tuned queries, indexes, and schema designs, improving transaction throughput by 3x and supporting 99.99% system

uptime with HA configurations.

Multithreading & Concurrency

Leveraged Java’s concurrency APIs to implement parallel task execution, reducing processing time by 65% for high-

volume batch jobs and improving system throughput from 300 to 900 requests/second under peak load.

Cloud-Native Development & Deployment

Containerized and deployed 15+ microservices using Docker and Kubernetes, reducing deployment time by 70% and

enabling zero-downtime releases.

Managed Kubernetes clusters supporting 1M+ daily requests with 99.99% uptime and auto-scaling to handle traffic

spikes during peak hours.

Version Control & Team Collaboration

Led Git strategy and branching model implementation across 3 teams (15+ developers), reducing merge conflicts by 40%

and accelerating release cycles by 25% for large-scale backend projects

Senior Software Developer – HCL Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

QlikView Development:

Developed interactive QlikView dashboards and custom jQuery plugins that improved real-time data visualization speed by

30%, enabling faster decision-making for 50+ business users.

Web Application Development:

Designed and deployed responsive Spring MVC web applications with Ext JS and AngularJS, reducing page load time by

40% and increasing user engagement by 20% for over 10,000 monthly active users.

Collaboration & Communication:

Facilitated agile collaboration across cross-functional teams of 8-12 members, improving sprint delivery success rate by

25% and enhancing alignment between business and technical teams.

Software Developer – Speroware Technologies Pvt Ltd

Apr 2011 - Aug 2014

Designed and developed scalable, high-performance web applications over 3.5 years, serving 20,000+ monthly users using technologies like Spring MVC, MySQL, JSP, HTML5, jQuery, JSON, and AJAX.

Built interactive, responsive user interfaces and backend logic, resulting in a 35% reduction in page load times.

Integrated Google Protocol Buffers (protobuf) for data serialization, improving data transmission speed by 40% and reducing network latency.

Developed RESTful APIs and optimized MySQL queries, leading to a 25% improvement in query response time and enhanced overall application throughput.

Implemented asynchronous data processing and AJAX interactions, improving UI responsiveness and reducing user wait times by 20%.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams of 8+ members to gather business requirements and deliver tailored solutions.

Led efforts that increased customer satisfaction scores by 15% through effective feature delivery.

Facilitated clear stakeholder communication, contributing to a 30% reduction in project delays.

Applied Agile methodologies to consistently deliver projects on or ahead of schedule.

Education

B.Tech/B.E. | Electronics/Telecommunication

2010

Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU)

Marks - 64%

Additional information

Languages: Telugu, English
